If $\sigma$ is a symmetric shift matrix and ${}^{\nu}y_{n}(\sigma)$ is the semiclassical shifted Yangian then there is an isomorphism of commutative algebras $S(^{\nu}\mathfrak{c}_{n}(\sigma)^{\tau})\overset{\sim}{\longrightarrow}\operatorname{gr}R(^{\nu}y_{n}(\sigma),\tau)$ given by

$\displaystyle\begin{array}[]{lcl}\theta_{a,i,j;r-1}\longmapsto\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r)}+\operatorname{F}_{r-2}y_{n}(\sigma)&\text{ for all admissible }a,i,j,\ s_{a,a+1}(\nu)
$\hfill\qed$
6. The Dirac reduced semiclassical Brundan–Kleshchev homomorphism
6.1. The semiclassical Brundan–Kleshchev homorphism
Fix  $\varepsilon=\pm 1$  and an integer  $N>0$  such that  $\varepsilon^{N}=1$ . Let
$\lambda=(\lambda_{1}\leq\lambda_{2}\leq\cdots\leq\lambda_{n})\in\mathcal{P}_{\varepsilon}(N)$  be a partition associated with all parts of the same parity. Following Section 4.1 we choose a nilpotent element  $e\in\mathfrak{gl}_{N}$  with Jordan blocks of size  $\lambda_{1},...,\lambda_{n}$ , and an involution  $\tau:\mathfrak{gl}_{N}\to\mathfrak{gl}_{N}$  such that the fixed point subalgebra  $\mathfrak{g}=\mathfrak{gl}_{N}^{\tau}$  is simple of type
$\begin{array}[]{ccc}{\sf C}&\text{ when }&\varepsilon=-1\\
{\sf B}\text{ or }{\sf D}&\text{ when }&\varepsilon=1.\end{array}$

Since $\tau$ fixes the $\mathfrak{sl}_{2}$ -triple $(e,h,f)$ it also stabilises the slice $e+\mathfrak{gl}_{N}^{f}$ and acts by Poisson automorphisms on $S(\mathfrak{gl}_{N},e)$ .

Now let $(\sigma,\ell)$ be the $n\times n$ shift matrix and the level determined by $\lambda$ as in (2.1). We pick a $(-\varepsilon(-1)^{\lambda_{1}},\sigma)$ -admissible shape and by slight abuse of notation we also let $\tau$ denote the automorphism of ${}^{\nu}y_{n}(\sigma)$ described in (5.3).

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and Slodowy slices in classical Lie algebras
paper.abstract: In this paper we introduce the shifted twisted Yangian of type {\sf AI}, following the work of Lu--Wang--Zhang, and we study their semiclassical limits, a class of Poisson algebras. We demonstrate that they coincide with the Dirac reductions of the semiclassical shifted Yangian for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$. We deduce that these shifted twisted Yangians admit truncations which are isomorphic to Slodowy slices for many non-rectangular nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}. As a direct consequence we obtain parabolic presentations of the semiclassical shifted twisted Yangian, analogous to those introduced by Brundan--Kleshchev for the Yangian of type {\sf A}. Finally we give Poisson presentations of Slodowy slices for all even nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}, generalising the recent work of the second author.
